entities.name: Mammad Hasan agha Javanshir
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mammad Hasan agha Sarijali Javanshir was a military leader and major-general of the Russian army, son and heir of Ibrahimkhalil khan of Karabakh, father of major-general, public figure and poet Jafargulu agha Javanshir also ancestor of famous Azerbaijani singer Khan Shushinski. He was born in 1766, Shusha as first son of Ibrahim Khalil Khan and his principal wife Khanum agha from Jabrayilli clan.
